stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy learns that a certified pharmacy technician's certification from the certifying body lapsed last week. The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence remains current. Which consequences follow? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The individual is limited to the duties and responsibilities of a pharmacy technician.
The individual must use the title pharmacy technician.
The individual is counted as a pharmacy technician when calculating supervisory ratios.
The individual may no longer work in the pharmacy in any capacity.
The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence is automatically suspended.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 8.04(3) states three consequences when a certified pharmacy technician's certification lapses: the individual is limited to pharmacy technician duties under 247 CMR 8.02, must use the pharmacy technician title, and is counted as a pharmacy technician in the 247 CMR 8.06(3) supervisory ratios. The Board licence and the certifying body's certification are separate credentials.

choice_analysis.A: Correct: scope reverts to the pharmacy technician duties in 247 CMR 8.02.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: the title must change to pharmacy technician.
choice_analysis.C: Correct: the ratio consequence follows automatically and can break a four-person shift.
choice_analysis.D: The individual may continue working within pharmacy technician scope.
choice_analysis.E: A lapsed certification does not suspend the separate Board licence.

related_facts: A shift built on two certified pharmacy technicians can fall out of ratio the moment one certification lapses.
explanation.mpje_trap: The staffing-ratio consequence is the one most often missed; scope and title are only two of the three.

reasoning_steps: Separate the certifying body's certification from the Board technician licence
Apply the scope and title consequences of the lapse
Recompute the shift's supervisory ratio with the individual counted as a pharmacy technician
